# Project Estimation: Custom Reservation System for Acme Foods

### Meeting Summary:
Acme Foods, managing 15 restaurants, seeks a custom reservation platform to replace their disparate systems, which include manual paper logs and various software tools. The platform will integrate with their existing loyalty program, allow for seamless reservations across multiple locations, and track analytics for restaurant performance. The goal is to enable a user-friendly, web-first application with additional tablet support for restaurant managers. Phase one of the project targets deployment by early September 2025, aligning with the soft launch of a new flagship restaurant in Madrid. The budget allocated for this phase is around 30,000 EUR, which can stretch to 35,000 EUR if necessary.

### Estimation:

## Custom Reservation System for Acme Foods

### Task Breakdown

| Task | Description | Hours | Cost (EUR) |
|------|-------------|------:|------------|
| Requirements gathering and refinement | Confirm detailed requirements to align expectations for phase one and two. | 12 | 750 |
| Architecture and technical design | Design the overall architecture of the system, including multi-tenant strategy and integration points. | 20 | 1,250 |
| Database schema design & setup | Create schemas with row-level security for multi-tenancy using Postgres. | 14 | 875 |
| Core reservation engine | Implement core functionality for managing table availability and reservations with concurrency control. | 40 | 2,500 |
| Customer loyalty integration | Develop functionality to link customer reservations with loyalty points. | 20 | 1,250 |
| BCN-Touch POS integration | Build an interface for connecting reservations with the existing POS system to enrich billing data. | 16 | 1,000 |
| Legacy data migration | ETL process to import existing data from the old system. Classification of notes into structured fields where possible. | 24 | 1,500 |
| Admin and operational dashboards | Create dashboards for reporting on reservations, no-show rates, and bookings per restaurant. | 20 | 1,250 |
| User authentication and authorization | Implement OAuth2 for internal users, email magic links for customers, enhancing security measures. | 16 | 1,000 |
| UI/UX development for web application | Frontend development using React for mobile-friendly web interface, ensuring accessibility compliance. | 36 | 2,250 |
| Responsive design for tablet experience | Optimize restaurant manager interface for tablet usage, ensuring usability on a 10-inch screen. | 20 | 1,250 |
| Testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) | Rigorous testing plan covering all functionalities to ensure reliability and performance. | 28 | 1,750 |
| Documentation and training materials | Produce user manuals and system documentation for training restaurant staff. | 12 | 750 |
| Deployment setup and infrastructure | Prepare AWS services including ECS Fargate, monitoring, and CI/CD setups for seamless deployment. | 14 | 875 |
| Compliance measures for GDPR | Ensure platform adheres to GDPR requirements, including right-to-erasure and data export features. | 10 | 625 |

### Totals

- **Total hours:** 400
- **Total cost:** 25,000 EUR

### Recommended Team

- 1 Senior Full-Stack Developer (lead)
- 1 Mid-level Backend Developer
- 1 Mid-level Frontend Developer
- 1 UI/UX Designer (part-time until phase one completion)
- 1 QA Engineer (part-time towards end of development)

### Estimated Duration

**16 weeks** with a four-person core development team.

---

### Additional Considerations:
- **Phase Two Considerations**: The enhancements, including HubSpot integration and “smart suggestions” for user interaction, must be planned for subsequent releases due to time constraints in phase one.
- **Legacy Database Access**: Access to the existing database will need to be ensured for the migration, including permissions for data engineers during the ETL phase.
- **Communication Protocols**: Regular progress updates will be necessary, with bi-weekly stakeholder meetings scheduled to align development with evolving requirements.

This estimation aims to align closely with the discussed needs of Acme Foods while remaining within the constraints of budget and timeline set forth in the meeting. The project will deliver a scalable, user-friendly system that addresses current pain points, paving the way for growth and efficient reservation management across all locations.
